[EFFECT] Being a holiday produces a small negative contribution to predicted demand compared with a normal working day, which is near zero. The effect is a simple step: non-holidays are essentially neutral and holidays slightly reduce the model's prediction.
[IMPORTANCE] Ranked last (ninth) with the lowest importance score — its effect is negligible and should not meaningfully influence operational planning on its own.
[RECOMMENDATION] Plan your bike availability and staffing primarily around the hour of the day — ensuring high fleet availability and staff support around the 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. peaks — and secondarily around temperature, scaling up resources on warm days (around 20–31 °C) and scaling back on cold or very rainy days.
